name: Jorge Dias
life: “I still remember being laughed at for reading with my finger.” Saturday often includes a stop at Harbour Bakery, where Jorge buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I borrowed it after failing a reading test. This is the first time I've finished the last page.
appearance: Jorge is easy to recognize by short black hair swept back and a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth. Usually dressed in a long navy raincoat with a pen clipped inside the neckline, Jorge rubs a thumb along the edge of the nearest pocket when listening.
personality: Jorge enjoys bargaining, including over things already settled. It is partly a joke and partly a test of whether the other person feels able to say no.
agenda: To finish the library reading in front of the original lender.
family: Audrey Kahn is Jorge’s first cousin once removed. Jorge makes room at the table. Audrey brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *The misplaced umbrella*, Audrey says, “I rented the parasol by the hour. Its whole day's income is now sitting over a street chess game.”
connections: Byron Carbone. They turn the unpaid fine into a reading the former pupil actually wants to finish.

reactions.situation: The former pupil offers to pay forty years of fines
reactions.response: Jorge asks the library what it actually needs from the returning reader.

reactions.situation: A neighbor offers to pay for a favor that was meant kindly
reactions.response: Jorge accepts a small agreed amount if paying lets the neighbor keep their pride.

reactions.situation: When a friend starts agreeing too quickly
reactions.response: Jorge puts the deal away and suggests a walk.
